vulnerable.description: Original unsafe SQL restored from upstream; equivalent to mutation of parameterized control.

control.description: Parameterized SQL; protected against tested SQL injection, NOT globally SAFE.

data_flow.source: LLM-selected GetUserTransactions tool argument userId; simulated by the validation harness.
data_flow.sink: TransactionDb.get_user_transactions interpolates the argument into a SQL query executed by SQLite.

validation.summary: In-memory SQLite via extracted original tool wrapper and a simulated tool-call dispatcher; ordinary and crafted model-output arguments. No live LLM attack claim.

assumptions: Agent-selected tool argument userId is untrusted.
Authorization is outside this case; parameterization does not prevent selecting another user by legitimate ID.
limitations: No live model inference is run.
The tool-call argument in the harness is simulated.
Authorization remains a separate unresolved issue in both variants.
